notes.title: Hello Japan and China !
notes.notes: Languages such as [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Chinese[/b] [b]have been added[/b] to the main [b]KWARK[/b] languages. This is done for our favorite players from [b]Asia[/b]! Now only the game description is in Japanese and Chinese, but in the near future the game itself will be in these wonderful languages!
